title: Blood gene expression under immunotherapy as potential biomarker for immune checkpoint blockade in non-small-cell lung cancer
platform: GPL570 Affymetrix Human Genome U133 Plus 2.0
note: Epithelial genes in blood are expected to be low / shed-tumor signal. Named probes sit below the array-wide median; public deposit has regimen and cycle-4 timepoint but no PFS / RECIST / IO-benefit labels. Detection is the result. Cycle-4 deltas are recorded for the named probes only.
